note: Hobbies (spec §4 'recovery, hobbies and minigames'; §19 'rest and friendship can be appropriate choices'). A hobby is a free-slot choice that is not soccer: it moves wellbeing and, for some, school or fatigue, and never a soccer attribute or verified evidence. One hobby at a time, one session a day; switching keeps the total but restarts the milestone count. `every` effects land on every n-th session of that hobby (a reading habit helps school; a gaming habit costs it). Milestones queue authored moments from content/story/hobbies-u11.json. Numbers are proposals (OPEN_QUESTIONS #38).
